notes: Class A trades on Nasdaq and the TSX under the same symbol, SHOP; the Nasdaq line (USD, the reporting currency; the TSX line is SHOP.TO in CAD) is used. Both are direct listings of the same shares, not ADRs. The FY2025 10-K says 'Our Class B restricted voting shares and Founder share are not listed for trading or quoted on any exchange or market.' The single Founder Share, which carries variable votes and, per the 10-K/A, 'represents a de minimis percentage of the total issued and outstanding shares', is left out.
